tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Enhance your conference room communication with the SNOM C520 3-SIP PoE Black IP Conference Phone—a professional-grade, wireless VoIP conference phone designed for dynamic work environments in Bangladesh. Whether you're in a small office, call center, or educational institution, the SNOM C520 offers crystal-clear HD audio, a 2.4-inch color LCD display, and long battery life to keep you connected throughout the day.


Its DECT 6.0 technology ensures secure and reliable wireless communication, while the included cradle provides convenient charging and docking. With Over-the-Air (OTA) software updates, the C520 ensures your device stays current with the latest features and security enhancements.


Key Technical Specifications

  • Model: SNOM C520
  • Type: Cordless DECT IP Conference Phone
  • Display: 2.4" TFT color LCD, 240 x 320 pixels, backlit
  • Audio: HD wideband audio, full-duplex speakerphone
  • Battery: 1500 mAh Li-ion; up to 12 hours talk time; up to 200 hours standby
  • Charging Time: Approximately 6 hours
  • Keypad: 31 hard keys including 12-key ITU telephone keypad, 5-way navigation key, 6 programmable LED function keys, 4 dedicated audio keys
  • Wireless Standard: DECT 6.0
  • Compatibility: Works with SNOM M500 DECT base stations
  • Security: Supports TLS encryption and SRTP for secure communication
  • Additional Features: Belt clip, Over-the-Air (OTA) software updates, Shared Call Emulation (SCE), Paging, Intercom
  • Dimensions: 130 x 50 x 25 mm
  • Weight: 130g (including battery and belt clip)
